out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The 2025 health department permit was posted but not the 2026 permit.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. The PIC located the 2026 permit and posted it during the inspection to correct. CDI.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: A plastic food container was stored in the hand sink next to the ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Discontinue storing any equipment in the handsink and ensure it is only used for washing hands. The PIC moved the container during the inspection to correct. CDI. LE PAIN QUOTIDIEN (Inspection Date: 05/26/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. There was no “employees must wash hands” sign at the hand sink next to the ware-washing area, such as the ones located at the other hand sinks.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. Please provide a “employees must wash hands” sign at the hand sink as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Chemical Sanitizing, Contact Time Met
violations.observation: The concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution at the dish washer was 0 ppm. The concentration of the quaternary ammonia sanitizing solution at the three compartment sink was 0 ppm. Both sanitizer containers were empty.
violations.corrective_action: Chemical sanitization (manual or mechanical operations) including the application of sanitizing chemicals by immersion, manual swabbing, brushing, or pressure spraying methods using a solution by providing: 1) an exposure time of at least 10 seconds for a chlorine solution, 2) an exposure time of at least 7 seconds for a chlorine solution of 50mg/L that has a pH of 10 or less and a water temperature of 100F or a pH of 8 or less and a water temperature of 75F, 3) an exposure time of at least 30 seconds for other chemical sanitizing solutions, or 4) an exposure time used in relationship with a combination of temperature, concentration, and pH that when evaluated for efficacy yields sanitization. The PIC replaced the sanitizer at both stations and reprimed the systems. The dish washer was sanitizing with chlorine at 50 ppm and the three compartment sink was sanitizing at 200 ppm before the inspection concluded. CDI.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Air/Water Thermometers Accuracy, Only Degrees F
violations.observation: The digital thermometer on the main prep unit (the 9 drawer Randell unit) was not accurate. It was reading 7ºF.
violations.corrective_action: Ambient air and water temperature measuring devices that are scaled only in Fahrenheit shall be accurate to +/-3 degrees F in the intended range of use. Please repair or replace the thermometer, or install a second one inside the unit so that the unit’s holding temperature can be monitored. The PIC installed a second thermometer in the unit during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. There was no handsoap available at the hand washing sink behind the front counter. The dispenser was empty tor broken.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. The manager submitted a work order to have the dispenser checked and purchased handsoap from a local establishment during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. There was “no employee must wash hands” sign in the second restroom.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. The manager corrected this by creating a sign and installing in the restroom during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: unsalted butter and maple butter were 75 and 77° on the counter. Cut tomatoes in the walk-in for 52°.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The unsalted butter and maple butter were discarded to the temperature of use. The tomatoes were prepared three hours ago and we’re still cooling. CDI.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Wet wiping cloths were stored on the counter and not in a the sanitizer solution provided.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. The EHS discussed this with the manager. The wiping cloths were placed in the solution. CDI.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: food scoop handles were stored in the quinoa, squash and farro products in the 9 drawer refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. The manager discussed this with the food employee and removed the scoops from the foods to have them washed rinsed and sanitized. CDI.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED BOTH ENGLISH AND SPANISH COPIES OF THE PROCEDURE.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED AN UNAPPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PLEASE REPLACE THE UNAPPROVED SPLITTER WITH AN APPROVED ONE AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS.
